_comment: GET /koreader/plugin/catalog/books/43 for a book with an audiobook and an EPUB with narration, shaped by the pinned server (koreader-catalog.service.ts:1218-1280 file mapping, :1318-1331 enrichDeliveryFiles). Without a variant the EPUB lists the source file's hash but the download streams an audio-free rebuild (:812-825), so a hash check fails; with the reader's delivery variant the file carries a selection and the prepared artifact's hash. Hashes are placeholders.
